On top of the barrel is a white, somewhat amorphous object that appears to be a lid or inlet mechanism, but it looks structurally soft and ill-defined. To the left are two smaller containers: a translucent brown jar and a beige cup. In the foreground lies a coiled wire or hose. A palm plant is visible in the background against a wall.
